Hi Tara — great to hear from you. Short answers up front, then a simple attached rate card and CSV. Attachments: ratecard_redwood_v1.pdf, example_pricing_sheet.csv

Baseline pricing (hosted API, USD):
- Per-vector (recommended for most vector-store workflows):
  - 768-d: $0.00080 / vector
  - 1536-d: $0.00190 / vector
  - 2048-d: $0.00340 / vector (higher compute; recommended for select high-precision indexes)

- Per-1k tokens equivalence (for direct text-to-embed comparisons):
  - text-embedding-3-small (approx 768-d): $0.55 / 1k tokens
  - text-embedding-3-large (approx 1536-d): $1.25 / 1k tokens

Volume discounts (hosted API):
- No commit: list price above
- 12-month commit tiers (monthly avg):
  - >=1M vectors/month: 15% off list
  - >=5M vectors/month: 22% off list
  - >=20M vectors/month: 30% off list
- We can structure billing either per-vector or a blended per-1k-token for legacy comparisons.

Model / dimension mapping (hosted):
- text-embedding-3-small -> 768-d (low-latency, cost-efficient for search)
- text-embedding-3-large -> 1536-d (balanced accuracy vs cost)
- text-embedding-3-xl or custom quantized variants -> 2048-d (experimental / higher precision)

Notes & recommended next steps:
- For your 1.2M monthly vectors we usually recommend 1536-d for quality; at that volume the 15% 12‑month commit is a common ask.
- If procurement needs a one-line commercial offer, we can pre-authorize a provisional 15% off list for a 12-month 1M-mo commit and generate a DocuSign SOW.
- I'll include an example CSV that maps dims to price and a one-page PDF summary (attached).

Let me know if you want me to loop in finance/legal for an initial SOW or share an estimated monthly invoice.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
